edges.reason: Coal blocks are embedded in the forest floor; player must navigate into the forest to reach them
Pumpkins are located on the forest floor among the trees; requires forest exploration
Red tulips grow in clearings within the forest; player must be in the forest to find them
Sugar cane grows along the river at the western edge of the forest; forest exploration leads to the water
The cabin containing the potted fern is visible from the forest's eastern edge; forest exploration reveals the cabin
Soul torches are in the cabin's basement antechamber; player must first enter the cabin then descend via ladder
Nether brick wall corridor is accessed via second ladder below the soul-torch-lit antechamber
Chest containing 4 nether quartz is embedded in the nether brick wall corridor; needed to craft quartz_block

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing with max_distance=4 targeting the center of the oak tree cluster at (-12, 0, -12), which is ~17 blocks from spawn. This forces the player to walk INTO the forest rather than detecting it from spawn. facing_tolerance=180 (no facing requirement) because being physically surrounded by trees IS finding the forest — direction is irrelevant when you're inside it.

Uses inventory_has for 'coal' with min_count=9 because mining a coal_block without Silk Touch drops exactly 9 coal items (not the coal_block itself). The player starts with no coal and is given a regular iron_pickaxe. Obtaining 9 coal confirms they successfully mined at least one coal_block from the forest floor.
Uses inventory_has because mining a pumpkin drops a pumpkin item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no pumpkins. Pumpkins are on the forest floor at (-10,0,-9) and (-15,0,-12).

Uses inventory_has because breaking a red_tulip flower drops the red_tulip item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no red tulips. Red tulips are scattered in the forest at (-12,0,-10), (-14,0,-11), (-9,0,-13).

Uses position_near_with_facing targeting the middle sugar cane block at (-16, 0, -6) on the river bank, ~22 blocks from spawn. max_distance=5 ensures the player must navigate to the western river edge — cannot be triggered from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at the sugar cane, modeling visual discovery.

Uses position_near_with_facing targeting the potted_fern at (-3, 1, -11) inside the cabin. max_distance=5 ensures the player is inside or at the cabin doorway (door at -6,1,-12 is ~3.2 blocks from fern). facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking at the potted fern.

Uses position_near_with_facing targeting the soul torch at (-4, -4, -12) in the upper basement antechamber. max_distance=4 ensures the player has descended the first ladder (from cabin floor y=0 to antechamber y=-4). Cannot be satisfied from the lower nether corridor (y=-7) because vertical distance alone would be ~3 blocks leaving only ~1 block horizontal tolerance, and the target is at y=-4 not y=-6.

Uses position_near_with_facing targeting the center of the north nether brick wall at (-4, -6, -13) in the lower basement corridor. max_distance=4 ensures the player has descended the second ladder (from antechamber y=-4 to corridor y=-7). Target at y=-6 (mid-height of wall spanning y=-7 to -5). Cannot be satisfied from the antechamber above because vertical distance from y=-4 to y=-6 is 2 blocks plus horizontal distance to z=-13 exceeds 4 blocks total.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a quartz_block (4 nether quartz in a 2x2 pattern on a crafting table) places the result in the player's inventory. The player starts with no quartz_block. The 4 nether quartz are obtained from the chest at (-4, -7, -12) in the nether corridor. The player has a crafting table in their starting inventory.

scene_description: A compact forest scene (NW quadrant, ~17 blocks from spawn) with 7 oak trees, coal blocks, pumpkins, and red tulips. A river with sugar cane runs along the forest's western boundary. A cabin at the forest's eastern edge contains a potted fern on the main floor, with south-facing ladders descending to a two-part basement: a soul-torch-lit antechamber (y=-4), then a nether brick wall corridor (y=-7) with a chest containing nether quartz for crafting.
task_text: Explore the forest to mine coal blocks, pumpkins, and red tulips. Find sugar cane by the river. Enter the cabin to find the potted fern, then descend the ladder to the basement. Navigate past the soul torches in the antechamber to reach the nether brick wall corridor. Open the chest and craft a quartz block from the nether quartz inside.
design_notes:
FINAL APPROVED LAYOUT:

1. FOREST (NW, centered ~-12,0,-12): 7 oak trees from x=-9 to -17, z=-7 to -15. Coal blocks at ground level, pumpkins and red tulips scattered. ~17 blocks from spawn.

2. RIVER (far west, x=-17/-18, z=-8 to -2): Water at y=-1. Sand at x=-16, y=-1 ADJACENT to water at x=-17, y=-1 (same Y-level). Sugar cane at x=-16, y=0 on sand.

3. CABIN (forest eastern edge, x=-6 to -1, z=-14 to -9): Oak plank structure. Door opening at west wall (-6, y=1-2, z=-12). Potted fern at (-3, 1, -11) on oak plank floor.

4. UPPER BASEMENT / ANTECHAMBER (y=-4 to -1): Stone walls. Accessed via south-facing ladder at (-2, y=-1 to -4, z=-11) — backing block is stone at z=-10. Soul torches at (-4,-4,-12) and (-3,-4,-12) on stone floor at y=-5.

5. LOWER BASEMENT / NETHER CORRIDOR (y=-7 to -5): Nether brick walls on west (x=-5), east (x=-2), and north (z=-13) walls. Accessed via south-facing ladder at (-3, y=-4 to -7, z=-11) — backing block is nether_bricks at z=-10. Chest at (-4,-7,-12) with 4 nether quartz.

6. LADDER FIX APPLIED: All ladders face=south, backing against solid blocks at z=-10 (stone upper, nether_bricks lower). Verified by CommonSenseAgent and ValidatorAgent.

7. PLAYER EQUIPMENT: Crafting table + iron pickaxe via /give.
